recommendations.title: Dollar spot risk is elevated
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 29% (threshold 20%). Inspect turf closely for early straw-coloured lesions and consider a preventative fungicide application.

recommendations.title: Microdochium patch risk is building
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 2/4. Conditions are turning favourable for the disease — increase monitoring frequency, especially after the next rain.

recommendations.message: Modelled leaf wetness probability is 61%, which raises disease pressure. Avoid evening irrigation and improve airflow/mowing height where practical.

recommendations.message: Wind is forecast up to 24 km/h, above the typical safe spraying range — drift risk is elevated. Wait for calmer conditions.

recommendations.title: Water balance is in a healthy range
recommendations.message: 7-day net balance is +19mm — no irrigation action needed today.

recommendations.title: Growth potential is high today
recommendations.message: Today's growth potential is 94% of maximum. Temperature is close to optimal for growth — a good day for mowing, and nitrogen will be used efficiently if feeding is due.
